request: Reconcile the v1 endpoint inventory, usage export, known consumers, replacement API docs, migration examples, support tickets, test status, draft notice, and cutoff date I supplied. Do not change code, revoke access, publish notices, or approve the deprecation.
scope: Platform, developer-relations, product, and engineering teams preparing a controlled API deprecation while service owners retain release and communication authority.

evidence.title: Deprecated API surface and usage-evidence register

evidence.title: Consumer impact, migration, exception, and compatibility-risk ledger

blockers.reason: Do not change code, disable endpoints, revoke credentials, publish notices, contact consumers, approve timelines, or certify migration completion

ownerActions.action: No production change, notice, credential action, timeline approval, or migration certification is performed

prohibitedActions: Do not change code, disable endpoints, revoke credentials, publish notices, contact consumers, approve timelines, or certify migration completion
